title: Written on Our Hearts
old_p1: Heavenly Father made a promise through Jeremiah. “I will make a new covenant,” He said. A covenant is a special two-way promise between Heavenly Father and His people.
Long before, His law was written on flat stones for Moses. A law is a rule that helps us live well. This new covenant would be different.
old_p2: “I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts,” He said. Inside them, it would go everywhere they went.
“They shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest.” Least means the littlest. Many years later, Jesus came and brought this new covenant.
That means you, little one. Tonight, rest your hand on your heart and feel the good He wants to write there.
p1: Long before Jeremiah, Heavenly Father gave His people good rules called His law. Moses brought them down, written on flat stones.
But the people did not keep their promises to Him. They knew His rules, but the rules were not in their hearts.
So Heavenly Father gave Jeremiah a new promise. He said, “I will write my law in their hearts.” Then His good ways would live inside them.
p2: He called it a new covenant, a special promise with Heavenly Father. Everyone would know Him, from the littlest child to the biggest grown-up. Many years later, Jesus brought this new covenant.
You can know Heavenly Father too. Tonight, put your hand on your heart. Ask Him to help you keep His good ways inside.
